Create a production-ready Android app named "JARVIS AI".

Goal:
Build a personal AI voice assistant for Android, inspired by a futuristic JARVIS-style assistant.

Technology:
- Kotlin
- Jetpack Compose
- Modern Android architecture
- Material 3
- Android permissions handled properly
- Clean, modular and maintainable code

Main features:

1. VOICE ASSISTANT
- Microphone button on the main screen.
- Speech-to-Text for voice commands.
- Support Hindi, Hinglish and English commands.
- Show the recognized command on screen.
- Text-to-Speech response.
- Assistant should respond naturally.

2. AI CHAT
- AI conversation screen.
- User messages and JARVIS responses.
- Conversation history stored locally.
- Typing/loading animation while AI is responding.
- Handle API errors gracefully.

3. JARVIS COMMANDS
Implement command recognition for:
- Open YouTube
- Open Chrome
- Open Google
- Open Maps
- Open Settings
- Open installed apps when Android allows it
- Show battery percentage
- Show device information
- Tell current time/date
- Set alarm
- Create reminder
- Make phone call after explicit user confirmation
- Send SMS after explicit user confirmation

4. SAFETY
- Never make a phone call or send SMS silently.
- Ask the user for confirmation before sensitive actions.
- Request Android permissions only when required.
- Respect Android background execution and microphone restrictions.
- Do not attempt to bypass Android security restrictions.

5. UI
Create a futuristic JARVIS interface:
- Dark background
- Glowing blue/cyan elements
- Central animated AI orb
- Microphone button
- Voice waveform animation
- Assistant status: Listening / Thinking / Speaking
- Chat history
- Modern animations
- Responsive design

6. HOME SCREEN
Display:
"JARVIS AI"
"Your Personal AI Assistant"

Include:
- AI orb
- Start Listening button
- Text command input
- Recent conversation
- Battery status
- Current time

7. SETTINGS
Include:
- Assistant name
- User name
- Language
- Voice speed
- Voice pitch
- Text-to-Speech enable/disable
- Dark theme
- AI API configuration
- Clear conversation history

8. ARCHITECTURE
Use:
- MVVM
- Repository pattern where appropriate
- ViewModel
- StateFlow
- Coroutines
- Separate modules/classes for:
  Voice recognition
  Text-to-Speech
  AI communication
  Command processing
  App launching
  Device information
  Alarm/reminders
  Conversation storage

9. IMPORTANT
Generate all required files:
- settings.gradle.kts
- build.gradle.kts
- app/build.gradle.kts
- AndroidManifest.xml
- Kotlin source files
- Compose UI files
- Resources
- Themes
- Icons/placeholders if required

The project must compile in Android Studio.

Do not leave pseudocode or TODO placeholders for core functionality.

At the end:
- Show complete project structure.
- Explain where to put any API key.
- Explain required permissions.
- Explain how to build the APK.
- Explain how to install the APK on an Android phone.
